pick.name: claude.ai Google Drive/Gmail/Calendar connectors
pick.what: First-party OAuth connectors synced to Claude Code
pick.why: No Google Cloud OAuth client to create

best_free.name: workspace-mcp (taylorwilsdon)
best_free.free_limits: Free; you must create your own Google Cloud OAuth client with the needed APIs enabled
best_free.install: uvx workspace-mcp --tool-tier core  (stdio), or uvx workspace-mcp --transport streamable-http --tool-tier core then claude mcp add --transport http workspace-mcp http://localhost:8000/mcp

alts.name: gws (googleworkspace/cli)
alts.what: One CLI for all of Google Workspace with 40+ agent skills (not an official Google product)
alts.why: Works through Bash; no MCP server to run

candidates.name: workspace-mcp
candidates.verdict: full mailbox token on disk; higher risk

candidates.name: Zapier / Composio connectors
candidates.verdict: hosted; third-party token custody; not opened

decision: Use the first-party claude.ai connectors for a personal or business Google account; avoid pointing them at accounts governed by someone else's data policy. workspace-mcp stores a full mailbox token on disk.

verify.note: Shallow check: no neutrality, pricing or licence defect found; not re-fetched.
